summary: Regression-tested public AFT APIs and mobile Expo UI. Core persistence, multi-item-capable order API, tips-excluded accounting, navigation, and sale modal pass; Reports date editing causes a React red screen.

ui_bugs.issue: Changing the custom date range triggers an uncaught React error: 'destroy is not a function', rendering the red error screen.

issues: No Settings navigation or Google login/status UI is present.
PDF export control is absent; only CSV export buttons are present.

action_items: Fix Reports useEffect cleanup: do not return the Promise from run() as an effect cleanup; use an async function inside the effect.
Add the requested Settings screen and managed Google login/status flow.
Add PDF export UI and a functioning PDF endpoint/export flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports defines useEffect(run,[start,end]) while run returns api(...).then(...); React treats the returned Promise as cleanup, causing 'destroy is not a function' on date changes.
Menu PUT persistence is fixed, but the mobile Items screen still has no edit/delete controls.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (navigation/sale modal pass; Reports date flow fails)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned TEST-prefixed regression records for order, purchase, and expense APIs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test credentials file exists but contains no credentials; auth testing was not possible. Public endpoint is configured in frontend/.env as EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open Reports, edit either date input. The component re-renders and React invokes the value returned by useEffect; because run returns a Promise from api(...).then(setR), React attempts to call it as destroy(). Mitigation: useEffect(() => { let active=true; (async()=>{const data=await api(...); if(active)setR(data)})(); return ()=>{active=false}; }, [start,end]).
